title: (PDF) Mushroom Cosmetics: The Present and Future
abstract:
Mushrooms contain polysaccharides like lentinan and ergosterols that exhibit significant anti-aging properties, with effects reported in various cosmetic formulations since the 1980s.
Mushrooms have been valued as a traditional source of natural bioactive compounds for centuries and have recently been exploited for potential components in the cosmetics industry. Numerous mushrooms and their ingredients have been known to be beneficial to the skin and hair. The representative ingredients are as follows: phenolics, polyphenolics, terpenoids, selenium, polysaccharides, vitamins, and volatile organic compounds.
Mushrooms contain polysaccharides like lentinan and ergosterols that exhibit significant anti-aging properties, with effects reported in various cosmetic formulations since the 1980s. Which mushrooms demonstrate notable antioxidant properties for skin health?add · Lentinula edodes and Volvariella volvacea show impressive antioxidant activities, correlated with their phenolic content, beneficial in cosmetic applications.
